notes: The two בְּעֵבֶר phrases are rightly read differently: the first spends a word on each morpheme ('on the other side') so rule 2 splits it with the copula on בְּ (rule 49), while the second is one word ('beyond') and fuses under rule 30 with the copula joining the fused unit. Arthrous rectum הָעֵמֶק takes the 'the' before 'valley' (rule 29). Written second אֲשֶׁר takes 'they that' (rule 46 first rider). Apodosis waw unrepresented.
